idea-plugin.name: Selection Bridge for Codex & Kimi
idea-plugin.description:
Share your current editor selection with the OpenAI Codex CLI or the Kimi Code CLI running in any terminal.

The plugin runs a local MCP (Model Context Protocol) server on 127.0.0.1:63450. Register it once with one click: Settings | Tools | Selection Bridge for Codex & Kimi → Register in Codex / Register in Kimi Code. Manual equivalents:

Codex:

codex mcp add idea-selection --url http://127.0.0.1:63450/mcp

Kimi Code: run /mcp-config inside kimi, or add to ~/.kimi-code/mcp.json:

{ "mcpServers": { "idea-selection": { "url": "http://127.0.0.1:63450/mcp" } } }

Then in any codex or kimi session just say "look at the code I selected in the IDE" — the agent calls the get_idea_selection tool and receives the file path, line range and selected text. Works with all JetBrains IDEs, and with any other MCP client that supports streamable HTTP.

Security note: the server listens on loopback only, but while the IDE is running any local process can query the current selection. Port and on/off switch: Settings | Tools | Selection Bridge for Codex & Kimi.

中文说明：把当前编辑器选中的代码通过本地 MCP 服务共享给终端里的 Codex CLI 或 Kimi Code CLI。 安装后按上面方式注册一次，之后在 codex / kimi 里说「看我在 IDE 里选中的代码」即可。
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.1.0 — Kimi Code CLI support, verified end-to-end against both codex and kimi (no protocol changes), plus one-click Register in Codex / Register in Kimi Code buttons in settings. 新增 Kimi Code CLI 支持（双端实测验证）与设置页一键注册按钮。
1.0.0 — Initial release: built-in streamable HTTP MCP server, get_idea_selection tool, configurable port, on/off switch.
